! Moving from No admin to No prompts: what the old tier added is removed.

1. [Hallway] Write Caddy's configuration, routing *.localhost to your apps and http://hallway.localhost:4480 to the dashboard (plain HTTP: no certificates), and check it with `caddy validate`
     /home/me/.hallway/generated/caddy.json
     /home/me/.hallway/generated/fallback.html
2. [Hallway] Run Caddy as you, on 127.0.0.1:4480, as a systemd user unit (hallway.caddy), with its admin API on a private socket
     /home/me/.hallway/state/caddy/admin.sock
3. [you] Remove Hallway's local certificate authority from your NSS database, as you, no sudo (No prompts doesn't use it)
     $ /usr/bin/certutil -d sql:/home/me/.pki/nssdb -D -n 'Hallway Local CA'   (may fail harmlessly)
4. [Hallway] Switch config.yaml to fronted mode, No prompts: links become http://<app>.localhost:4480
5. [Hallway] Check http://hallway.localhost:4480 answers

Nothing was run. `hallway setup` runs these.
